title: Astrid and the Undertow
author: Xanthe Eastwick
blurb: Petra Thornbury, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
